title: Olá Miami
customer: Miami hotels with a growing share of Brazilian guests (the guests use it, the hotel pays)
problem: Brazilian guests get service built for English and Spanish speakers.
solution: A Portuguese-language concierge on WhatsApp, white-labeled for each hotel, with bookable local partners.
valueProp: Higher guest satisfaction and on-property spend from a fast-growing segment, with no new staff.
revenueModel: Monthly subscription per hotel, plus a commission on bookings.
whyNow: Brazil is now Florida's #2 source market.
openQuestions: How many Brazilian guests does a typical Miami Beach hotel get? (source to find)

sources.label: VISIT FLORIDA, 2025: 143.3 million visitors in 2025 (preliminary): 131.1M domestic, 9.3M overseas, 2.9M Canadian. Brazil is now the #2 international source

author: Carla
